acceptanceCriteria: A note containing a listed value is refused with SECRET_DETECTED.
The refusal contains no part of the value.
The screen applies to ticket notes, know-how and obligation text.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1045 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem The secret screen catches credential-shaped text but not literal values already known to be secret (for example values in local environment files), nor emails, phone numbers or card-like numbers. Agent-written shared notes can leak both. Current workaround A scrubber loads the values from local environment files and rejects any note containing one, plus regular expressions for personal-data classes. Proposal Policy `knowHow.screen {denyValuesFile, classes: [email, phone, card]}`. Values are compared, never echoed or stored; a refusal names the class, not the value. See beamfall/corvint#1045 for the full text.
title: know-how screen: adopter-declared secret values and opt-in personal-data classes (issue #1045)
